manifest_summary.approach: Long-only public-close trend: last close above 20-bar mean and 10-bar mean above 20-bar mean. Target 85 percent marked equity when bullish, cash otherwise; a 5 percent equity no-rebalance band limits turnover. Buys retain at least 15 percent of cash as a next-close execution buffer, not a guarantee.
manifest_summary.changes: Round 2: use supplied current cash and held units rather than the previous fixed initial cash assumption; add portfolio-aware target and turnover band. Uses only public bars and own holdings. No verified improvement claimed.

manifest_summary.approach: Independent long-only trend persistence with a two-condition downside exit: sell existing units only when the public close is below its 20-bar mean and 20-bar momentum is negative; otherwise retain the portfolio without trading.
manifest_summary.changes: Competition-native next-close decision using only published index bars and current holdings. No offline AAPL performance assumptions, no new buys, and no improvement claim.
